subject: Update module api generation and format module.c (#2757)
reason: The change touches only doc comments and whitespace in src/module.c (reflowed example code in comments, 'redis.call()' renamed to 'server.call()' in a comment, and the VM_RegisterCommandFilter signature re-wrapped across lines with no code change) and rewrites utils/generate-module-api-doc.rb, a Ruby script that generates module API documentation and is never part of the server binary. No runtime behavior, reply, module ABI, replication, or persistence path changes, so there is nothing a scenario could exercise.
